QUOTE: "Library code:** nothing. The index finds no threads spawned from `library/`. Every `threading.c` function and every `mbedtls_threading_*` mutex is gated by `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`"; "Every lock goes through the function pointer `mbedtls_mutex_lock`, which defaults to `threading_mutex_lock_pthread` (`library/threading.c:103`)."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states library/ spawns no threads and also that library/threading.c supplies the mutex abstraction (mbedtls_mutex_lock and the threading mutexes) that callers use.
